input_data.message: A comprehensive e-commerce mobile application for fashion retail. The app will enable users to browse products, add items to cart, make secure payments, track orders, and manage their profiles. Key features:  - Product catalog with advanced filtering (category, size, color, price range) - Personalized recommendations using ML algorithms - Shopping cart and wishlist management - Multiple payment methods (credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay) - Real-time order tracking with push notifications - User reviews and ratings system - Social sharing features - Augmented reality try-on for clothing items - Multi-language support (English, French, German, Spanish) - Admin dashboard for inventory and order management  The app must handle 50,000+ concurrent users during peak shopping seasons, integrate with existing ERP systems, and comply with GDPR regulations.
